import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_45/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_45/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
# Join Source3_45_0 and Source3_45_1 on the "city" column
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY ["Source3_45_0.city", "Source3_45_1.type"]
# Aggregations:
# COUNT(Source3_45_0.ride_id) -> Ride Count (integer)
# AVG(Source3_45_0.fare) -> Average Fare (float)
# MAX(Source3_45_1.driver_count) -> driver_count (integer)

grouped = df_joined.groupby(["city", "type"], as_index=False).agg(
    {
        "ride_id": "count",
        "fare": "mean",
        "driver_count": "max"
    }
)

# Rename columns to match target schema
grouped.rename(
    columns={
        "city": "city",
        "driver_count": "driver_count",
        "type": "type",
        "fare": "Average Fare",
        "ride_id": "Ride Count"
    },
    inplace=True
)

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
grouped["city"] = grouped["city"].astype(str)
grouped["driver_count"] = grouped["driver_count"].astype(int)
grouped["type"] = grouped["type"].astype(str)
grouped["Average Fare"] = grouped["Average Fare"].astype(float)
grouped["Ride Count"] = grouped["Ride Count"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_45/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_45/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_45/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='city')

# Group by city, driver_count, type (leftmost non-float columns in target schema)
# Aggregations: Average Fare = AVG(fare), Ride Count = COUNT(ride_id)
result = joined.groupby(['city', 'driver_count', 'type'], as_index=False).agg({
    'fare': 'mean',
    'ride_id': 'count'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
result.rename(columns={
    'fare': 'Average Fare',
    'ride_id': 'Ride Count'
}, inplace=True)

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_45/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
